text:
alex.k: Quick heads-up — planning a microrelease cut for v0.27.1 today. Need final sign‑offs for version bump, changelog, QA smoke, and security. Branches: release/v0.27.1 (main), patch/v0.27.1-hotfix. Cutoff planned at 23:00 UTC.

maria.g: I can take docs + changelog. Will drop a short entry and example snippets. ETA 19:30 UTC.

jamal.r: CI's current green for release branch but we have a flaky test in routing that sometimes times out — CC @nate for flakes. If we need to rollback, we should keep patch branch ready.

nate: I'll triage the routing flake, should be a 20min fix or circumstantial. Posting PR soon: #5421.

claire: QA smoke windows? I can run a quick canary starting 20:15 UTC for 30m if that works. Need the canary image/a tag.

alex.k: @claire that's perfect. We'll tag the release candidate as v0.27.1-rc1 at 20:10 UTC. Canary window 20:15–20:45 UTC. If smoke passes -> proceed to cut.

sharon: Security review in progress. Quick note: dependency bump on grpc shows minor advisory (CVE-2024-xxxxx). I filed a short mitigation in the security ticket: SEC-311. I can sign off if dependency is patched or risk accepted with compensating controls.

maria.g: Changelog draft (short):

"- v0.27.1 (patch)
  - Fix: reduced routing timeouts for multimodal requests (#5421)
  - Docs: clarify manifest config for private deploys
  - Ops: improved canary logging for K/V cache"

alex.k: Copy. I'll add the version bump commit. Command I'll run: 
```
git checkout release/v0.27.1
bump2version patch --no-tag
git push origin release/v0.27.1
```

ci-bot: Pipeline status: release/v0.27.1 — 5/6 checks passing. flaky-tests job failing intermittently. Full CI log: https://ci.internal/boards/12345

jamal.r: Once CI is green, please ping me to cut the tag. I will also prepare a hotfix branch if we need to revert quickly.

claire: Canary simple checklist: 
- smoke login/auth flows
- sample generation latency (p95) under 350ms on dev-gpu
- end-to-end kv cache validation
I'll post results in thread.

sharon: SEC-311: if we can't bump grpc in time, I propose a temporary policy: deny external svc calls for the affected path + alerting. Will confirm by 18:45 UTC.

alex.k: Okay team — owners: @maria.g (docs/changelog), @jamal.r (CI/patch), @claire (QA/canary), @sharon (security). If all signoffs by 22:30 UTC, we cut at 23:00 UTC. If any blocker, call it and we'll delay. :thumbsup:

maria.g: Signed off on changelog and docs. :white_check_mark:

jamal.r: CI fix PR opened (#5421). Re-run queued.

ci-bot: Re-run triggered by jamal.r — build 7892 started. Expected finish ~20:05 UTC.

claire: Canary started 20:15 UTC. Posting quick numbers in 15m.

sharon: Security: grpc patch confirmed as low-risk after review. I can sign off. :eyes:

alex.k: All right — if CI and canary finish green, I'll bump and tag at 22:55 UTC for final validations, then cut at 23:00 UTC. Thanks everyone.

claire: Canary results: login/auth ✅, sample p95 320ms ✅, kv cache check ✅. No regressions observed.

ci-bot: Pipeline status: release/v0.27.1 — all checks passing. Build 7892 successful.

alex.k: Bumped and pushed tag v0.27.1. Cutting now. :shipit:

maria.g: Changelog published and docs updated.

jamal.r: Hotfix branch ready if needed: patch/v0.27.1-hotfix.

sharon: Security sign-off posted on SEC-311.

alex.k: Release complete. Rolling postmortem/notes in release board. Thanks team! :party:
